I'd make every human relentlessly curious about how the universe actually works—and allergic to comfortable lies. 

Not "curious" in the Instagram-inspiration sense. I mean the kind that keeps you up at night staring at equations or old maps or the night sky, the kind that treats sacred cows as potential barbecue. Once that catches fire, most of the other rot (tribalism, scarcity theater, self-deception, short-term thinking) starts starving on its own. Everything else is downstream of whether people actually want to know.
